features.name: Four player Careers
features.reason: Interpreter, Oracle, Survivalist and Trailblazer reuse core Skills/Talents and current advancement; no automatic core Career replacements.

features.name: Five weapon profiles and six purchases
features.reason: Printed market options remain; duplicate profiles are not overwritten.

features.name: Lizardman artillery
features.reason: Five readable profiles. Ranged Skill groups and prices are omitted in the source; no mechanical groups or purchases are invented.

features.name: Shroud of Fog
features.reason: Compatible new Shadows spell; situational effects are descriptive.

features.name: Curated mechanical references
features.reason: Disease/symptom procedures, weather, expedition actions and new Traits. No live disease, travel or combat automation.

features.name: Playable Skinks and Chameleon Skinks
features.reason: User explicitly chose NPC-only Skinks; no PC Species, starting resources or Career table is introduced.

features.name: Generic creatures and caste/mark templates
features.reason: 55 generic profiles, six castes and nine stacking sacred marks use the approved Size, Trait and Talent conversions. Named characters excluded.

features.name: High Magic and Mathlann prayers
features.reason: Four new High Magic spells and two distinct Elven-only Mathlann Miracles. Existing High Elf definitions remain; Slann choose explicit Lores/matching Winds.

features.name: Lustrian Career roll table
features.reason: Multiple overlapping/missing ranges, including High Elf Sailor/Smuggler and Dwarf/Halfling Smuggler/Stevedore. Probabilities are not guessed.

features.name: Named characters and campaign management
features.reason: Named foundations, colony/ship managers, live play and adventure scenes remain outside creator scope.
